read_first: authority:false deterministic membership routes for known person, parent, service-village, and assignment keys before any exact-team lookup
exact team owner for named small-group membership and doctrine
source force owner for aggregate manpower
only the referenced formation registry and formation rows needed by the operation
write_order: validate lawful team or force authority
conserve force manpower before creating, resizing, splitting, merging or releasing a formation
update exact team membership only through team organization commands
update formation state only for the explicit operational body
rebuild derived indexes if routing changed
invariants: A team is an exact roster of named people; it is not an aggregate manpower layer.
A formation is an aggregate operational body drawn from exactly one source force.
Named team members embedded in a formation are subsets of that formation headcount.
Large wars do not require one persistent team object for every ordinary squad.
Formation components are internal capability/accounting groups, not independent manpower owners.
Split and merge conserve headcount and represented material/history claims.
Tactical layouts are arrangements inside a team or formation and never create another organization.
Membership route shards are derived routing only; exact team and House owners remain authority, and keyed reads must not require scanning the global active-team registry.
